test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 30 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: What kind of anti-viral face mask was being developed under the 'Nano mission project' to fight against the Covid-19 pandemic in February 2022?

options.text: Copper-based nanoparticle coated anti-viral face mask
Biodegradable but non-washable anti-viral face mask

solution:
The correct answer is __**Copper-based nanoparticle coated anti-viral face mask**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A **copper-based nanoparticle coated anti-viral face mask** was being developed under the 'Nano mission project' to fight against the Covid-19 pandemic in February 2022.
 
• Copper nanoparticles are known for their strong anti-microbial properties, which can effectively neutralize viruses and bacteria.
 
• The development of such masks aimed to provide enhanced protection against the spread of Covid-19.
 
• The 'Nano mission project' focuses on harnessing the potential of nanotechnology to address critical health challenges.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Nanotechnology** involves manipulating matter at the nanoscale to create materials with unique properties and functions.
 
• The use of nanoparticles in face masks can enhance filtration efficiency and provide additional anti-viral protection.
 
• Face masks have been a crucial tool in mitigating the spread of Covid-19, and innovations in this area continue to evolve.
 
• The 'Nano mission project' is an initiative by the Government of India to promote and support research in nanoscience and nanotechnology.
 
• Such initiatives aim to leverage advanced technology to address public health crises and improve overall healthcare outcomes.
